class.name: GameOperation
class.brief_description: Retained operation for legacy and typed callers.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Return whether the operation has settled.

method.name: get_result
method.description: Return the detached legacy result or an empty dictionary while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Return the legacy result or an awaitable completion signal.

method.name: wait_result
method.description: Return the typed GameResult or an awaitable completion signal.

method.name: get_typed_result
method.description: Return the typed outcome or null before completion.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once with the legacy outcome.

signal.name: completed_typed
signal.description: Emitted once with the typed outcome of the same operation.
